text: From: White Collar Law360 <news@law360.com> To: Subject: 5 Ways Companies Can Prep For Biden's Anti-Corruption Push Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2021 07:35:33 +0000 iLaw360 White Collar WHITE COLLAR Thursday, June 17, 2021 TOP NEWS Analysis 5 Ways Companies Can Prep For Biden's Anti-Corruption Push With President Joe Biden gung-ho about fighting corruption, new anti-money laundering rules looming, and vulnerabilities that were amplified by the pandemic, companies should act now to reexamine and bolster their compliance programs, experts say.
